items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know, I didn't know Chu Berry (inaudible) so long because he and Roy were with Teddy Hill (inaudible).

ctx.x: somewhere on his style. And so they was, they liked each other, you know. And so, after that we got to be very close and friendly. And, we used to go out and go to a little jam session, hang out together. And Coleman, when we did a few, down to the small groups, we did a few concerts together.

Ben Webster was a beautiful tenor player for me, too. I didn't know, I didn't know Chu Berry (inaudible) so long because he and Roy were with Teddy Hill (inaudible). And then he went with Cab, and not too long after that, I think that's when he had that unfortunate accident somewhere on the road.
Tricky Sam. I don't know his name.
